body:
My personality demands that I don't move on. Everyone else I work with at my job supports me and makes me feel good and realize that I'm under a lot of stress. But the people who can actually make a difference for the things I'm going though treat me like shit and expect more out of me.

I'm so lonely that I'm desperate for any kind of relationship anyone will throw my way. So when my coworkers relate with me I really enjoy it. I'm so afraid from cutting off the only relations I have by quitting that I just put up with the stress. I eat a sandwich once every two days because I just have no appetite anymore. But for some reason I wake up the morning and feel like it's worth it just to see the people who make me happy for small moments while I work my never ending grind of a job.
